cases.name: rows-two-blocks
cases.covers: SSG2 with two row blocks + end marker, all column types, nullable columns, varied per-row serverVersion incl. the i64 safe-integer boundary

cases.name: crdt-column
cases.covers: SSG2 for a table with a crdt column (§2.4 tag 8, §5.10): the crdt value rides the bytes machinery (merged bytes, empty, and NULL)

cases.name: full-row-admission-values
cases.covers: Full rows keep decoding a string with U+0000 (§2.4 push admission values apply to sparse rows only); a canonical blob_ref whose name exercises every escape class (§5.9.1)

invalid.name: null-bit-on-non-nullable
invalid.covers: Null bitmap bit set for a non-nullable column

invalid.name: missing-end-marker
invalid.covers: Rows segment truncated before the mandatory rowCount = 0 end marker

invalid.name: json-column-not-json
invalid.covers: json column value that does not parse as a JSON document (SPEC.md §2.4 tag 5)

invalid.name: blob-ref-reordered-keys
invalid.covers: Full-row blob_ref that is not canonical (§5.9.1): byteLength before blobId

invalid.name: blob-ref-byte-length-exponent
invalid.covers: Full-row blob_ref that is not canonical (§5.9.1): byteLength written 1e2

invalid.name: blob-ref-byte-length-fraction
invalid.covers: Full-row blob_ref that is not canonical (§5.9.1): byteLength written 3.0

invalid.name: blob-ref-byte-length-negative-zero
invalid.covers: Full-row blob_ref that is not canonical (§5.9.1): byteLength written -0

invalid.name: blob-ref-whitespace
invalid.covers: Full-row blob_ref that is not canonical (§5.9.1): insignificant whitespace after the colons and comma

invalid.name: blob-ref-duplicate-key
invalid.covers: Full-row blob_ref that is not canonical (§5.9.1): byteLength twice; the parsed value serializes without the first

invalid.name: blob-ref-lone-surrogate-name
invalid.covers: Full-row blob_ref that is not canonical (§5.9.1): name holds an unpaired surrogate escape, the text JSON.stringify would write for it (JSON validity rule)
